meta.title: 面试10分钟定去留｜各轮面试到底在考察什么
meta.title_en: 10 Minutes That Decide: What Each Interview Round Tests

scenes.context: 面试官讲述为什么面试前十分钟甚至两三分钟就能决定要不要这个人——自我介绍阶段最能暴露逻辑思维与核心竞争力的表达。
sentences: 面的人多了，前十分钟甚至两三分钟就能决定这个人要不要。
After many interviews, you can decide within ten minutes — even two or three — whether to hire someone.
前十分钟就能决定：decide within the first ten minutes
面试官前面基本不提问，时间都在自我介绍上。
The interviewer barely asks questions early on; most time goes to your self-introduction.
基本不提问：barely ask questions
自我介绍最能看出逻辑思维是不是清楚的。
A self-introduction reveals whether your logical thinking is clear.
逻辑思维：logical thinking
paraphrase: 「面得多了就有经验」→ 经验积累
Interviewing a lot builds that intuition.
「通过表达感受能力」→ 从表达读能力
You can gauge someone's abilities through how they speak.
scenes.speak: After many interviews, you can decide within ten minutes — even two or three — whether to hire someone. The interviewer barely asks questions early on; most time goes to your self-introduction. A self-introduction reveals whether your logical thinking is clear.

scenes.title_cn: 一面看技能，二面看做事
scenes.title_en: Round one tests skills, round two tests work
scenes.context: 讲者拆解业务一面与二面的不同考察重点：一面由未来 mentor/leader 考察技能匹配，二面看整个人的做事与压力下的工作表现。
sentences: 第一轮业务初试的面试官，一般是你未来的 mentor 或 leader。
The interviewer in the first business round is usually your future mentor or leader.
未来的导师：your future mentor
一面更注重你的技能是不是能匹配到这个岗位。
Round one focuses on whether your skills match the position.
技能匹配岗位：skills match the position
二面看你能否在压力下很好地完成工作职责。
Round two looks at whether you can deliver your duties well under pressure.
在压力下：under pressure
paraphrase: 「技能能不能匹配岗位」→ 能力与岗位对齐
Whether your skills align with the role.
「整个人的做事」→ 综合工作表现
Your overall performance as a person.
scenes.speak: The interviewer in the first business round is usually your future mentor or leader. Round one focuses on whether your skills match the position. Round two looks at whether you can deliver your duties well under pressure.

scenes.title_en: Round three probes potential, HR probes impression
scenes.context: 讲者总结业务三面与 HR 面的考察重点，以及每轮面试都要单独准备的结论。
sentences: 业务三面看你的学习力、好奇心和整体潜力。
The third business round tests your learning ability, curiosity, and overall potential.
整体潜力：overall potential
HR 面评估你的印象程度和思维表达方式。
The HR round evaluates your impression and how you think and express yourself.
评估印象：evaluate your impression
每一轮面试都要准备不同的问答。
Every round needs a different set of prepared answers.
不同的问答：different sets of Q&A
paraphrase: 「善于借助工具尤其是 AI」→ 工具敏感度
Being good at leveraging tools, especially AI.
「不按常规出牌」→ 问题不按套路来
Questions don't follow a predictable pattern.
scenes.speak: The third business round tests your learning ability, curiosity, and overall potential. The HR round evaluates your impression and how you think and express yourself. Every round needs a different set of prepared answers.

practice: You can usually tell in the first ten minutes whether you want to hire someone.
I want to show that my skills match what this role needs.
I'm able to deliver under pressure.
Each round calls for its own preparation strategy.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：The interviewer decides whether to use this person.
✓ 地道说法：The interviewer decides whether to hire this person.
决定录用用 hire，不用 use this person。
✕ 直译腔：My self-introduction can show my thinking.
✓ 地道说法：My self-introduction reveals how clearly I think.
reveal + how clearly I think 更自然。
✕ 直译腔：Skills can match to this position.
✓ 地道说法：My skills align with what the role requires.
match 是及物动词，align with 更自然。
✕ 直译腔：They evaluate your impression degree.
✓ 地道说法：They evaluate the impression you make.
impression degree 是中文直译，用 the impression you make。
shifts: 以为面试是全方位长时间考察，前期表现随便
把前十分钟当作面试官做决定的主窗口，认真打磨自我介绍
一份自我介绍和一套答案应对所有轮次
按一面技能、二面做事、三面潜力、HR面印象分别准备
只背岗位技术题，遇到陌生问题就慌
建立体系化思考框架，让非常规问题也有章法可依
footer_notes: ASR 专有名词已按语境校正（如「业务出事」校正为「业务初试」、「数分的使用场景」校正为「数据分析的使用场景」、「跟团队成员的配配程度」校正为「配合程度」）。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
